conclusion: All 46 indexed INLONG and _Infinity3DP process profiles resolve seam_gap = 0, brim_object_gap = 0.1 mm and tree_support_branch_diameter_organic = 3.0 mm. Nine common process templates carry seam_gap; changing only those templates covers all selectable presets without copying process-only options into machine profiles. All 63 selectable machine/nozzle default-process links resolve these values. The common external bridge defaults remain bridge_flow = 1.05 and bridge_density = 105%; internal bridge settings are unchanged. Vendor bundle versions are INLONG 01.05.01.28 and _Infinity3DP 01.28.15.23 so the local resource updater recognizes this revision. Saved project and user-preset overrides are not rewritten. This reviewed record consolidates the previous brim-gap and bridge/organic-default facts with fresh snapshots.
